h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Mahbubnagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Mahbubnagar

items.pText: Mahbubnagar, the old Palamuru district of southern Telangana, is a dry region with hot summers and modest rainfall. Many of our enquiries from towns like this come from government and private schools with an open ground but a tight budget. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 610 km away, and sends it by road to sites across Telangana.

A large open ground does not need a large structure to be useful. A handful of well-placed individual pieces can serve a whole school if they are spaced properly. Send us the size of the ground, the number of students and some photos, and we will suggest a set of equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Getting the most from individual equipment

c: Individual pieces are a good way to start on a limited budget. A

keeps a group of children busy at once. A see-saw needs a partner, which gets children playing together, and a double swing set covers the most popular activity on any school ground. Spread them out so groups do not crowd one another, and leave the full safe zone around each.

Red soil and hard ground in this region are firm enough for grouted installation, and rubber flooring under swings and slides stops the area wearing into a dust bowl. When budgets allow, a multi play system can be added to the same layout. For adults, see our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 610 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What can a school in Mahbubnagar buy on a small budget?
items.a: Individual pieces such as a swing set, a see-saw and a merry-go-round. They serve many children at once and can be added to later as funds allow.

items.q: Do you supply schools across Telangana?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send equipment by road, with installation by our own team or a dealer in south India.

items.q: Is rubber flooring necessary on dry ground?
items.a: It is strongly advised under swings, slides and climbers. It cushions falls and keeps heavy-use spots from wearing into loose dust in the dry months.
